_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. Hartnell and Merced keep their catalogs on Coursedog (catalog.prod.coursedog.com and catalog.mccd.edu), a host the college read does not yet walk. A Coursedog catalog draws its pages from data its own scripts fetch, as curriQunet's and eLumen's do (S357, S380), so this read loads the programs view with "network": true and prints what the scripts fetched from the host. Pages only, no model call, no table write.

questions.catalog_source: Which addresses the catalog's scripts fetch its program list and one program's requirements from, and in what shape.
questions.program_list: What the Programs view lists: each program's title, award, id and the address of its page.
